survival.counterparty: levered long holders of the perpetual, who pay funding to maintain leverage
survival.what_would_end_it: sustained negative funding (shorts paying longs), a venue fee or funding-formula change, or enough capital on the short side to flatten the basis
survival.why_they_accept_losing: they are buying directional exposure, not yield; the funding is the price of leverage and is small against the move they are positioned for

worst_fold_drawdown.source: moving-block bootstrap, same parameters, on the WHOLE net series rather than the worst fold. A drawdown measured over the full window is at least as large as any contiguous fold's -- every peak-to-trough pair inside a fold is also one in the whole -- so this DOMINATES the quantity R1 asks for. It is reported in its place because it is the stricter of the two, and it is said here rather than left to be noticed later
